description: Source file defining functions for logging cookie-related events in the Chromium project, including cookie addition, deletion, rejection, and preservation, with sensitive data handling.

methods.name: NetLogCookieMonsterConstructorParams
methods.description: Creates a dictionary with the persistent store flag for logging.

methods.name: NetLogCookieMonsterCookieAdded
methods.description: Logs details when a cookie is added, including attributes like name, value, domain, path, security, priority, same-site, persistence, and party status.

methods.name: NetLogCookieMonsterCookieDeleted
methods.description: Logs details when a cookie is deleted, including name, value, domain, path, persistence, and deletion cause.

methods.name: NetLogCookieMonsterCookieRejectedSecure
methods.description: Logs details when a secure cookie is rejected, including old and new cookie values and paths.

methods.name: NetLogCookieMonsterCookieRejectedHttponly
methods.description: Logs details when an HttpOnly cookie is rejected, including old and new cookie values and paths.

methods.name: NetLogCookieMonsterCookiePreservedSkippedSecure
methods.description: Logs details when a secure cookie is skipped for preservation, including preserved and discarded values, domain, and path.
